title: VPN not connecting - Gateway not responding
description: Since this morning I cannot connect to the VPN from home. The client shows 'Gateway not responding'. I already restarted the VPN client but it still fails. I have a deadline today and need to reach the file share.

title: Oracle database extremely slow
description: Queries against the finance Oracle database are extremely slow and time out with ORA-01013: user requested cancel of current operation. Approximately 15 users in the finance team are affected and the month-end close is blocked.

title: Monitor blacks out after update
description: After last night's Windows update my external monitor goes black every few minutes and then comes back. I tried a different cable already but the monitor still blacks out.

title: Outlook crashes on startup
description: Outlook crashes immediately every time I open it. Event Viewer shows Faulting application name: OUTLOOK.EXE with exception code 0xc0000005. I need to send the client report by end of day.

title: VPN keeps dropping and laptop overheating
description: Two problems: (1) My VPN connection drops every 10 minutes and I keep losing unsaved work when it disconnects. (2) My laptop is also overheating, the fan is very loud and the CPU is at 100% most of the day.

title: Wi-Fi keeps dropping in Building B
description: The Wi-Fi keeps dropping on the 2nd floor of Building B. My laptop loses the wireless connection several times an hour and multiple colleagues on the same floor have the same problem.

title: Cannot log in to SQL Server reporting database
description: I am a new joiner and cannot connect to the reporting database. SQL Server Management Studio shows SQL Server error 18456: Login failed for user. My account was created yesterday.
